lines.text: How does a network recognize a face? Think of light passing through windows.
The first pane of glass only notices edges. Places where light meets dark.
The second pane combines edges into corners, curves and simple textures.
The third pane combines those into parts. An eye, a nose, a mouth.
The last pane combines parts into a whole. A face.
Nobody told it to look for eyes. Training pushed each pane toward whatever helped it get the answer right.
In many image networks, the layers end up working roughly like this.
